title: matched-budget baselines: correction-stage B1/B2/B3_d3/B4 under the selected g v2 protocol on 9 DEV datasets; NGSpice-call accounting; CMA-ES and TuRBO at the C0_refit budget on sky130 77 K
no_amendment: no amendment of the I19-1 TEST gate decisions (a755e18)
known_before: v1-era baseline rows of I4-1, I5-1, I6-1, I8-1, I9-1 (see prereg.md); no I22-1 value

arms.C0_refit_rerun: no correction, polish max_nfev 400 irls 2 diff_step 0.01, state C; validity VA1 and cost
arms.B1: base box + extras of the I4-1 edge screen (threshold 1e-4) recomputed on state-C starting records of all DEV devices (IHP: stored I5-1 per-class 300 K screen); max_nfev matched_nfev
arms.B2: base box + rext_ohm [0, 4 x series R per side / W] + heat_kappa [-0.5, 0.5]; max_nfev matched_nfev
arms.B3_d3: PolyCorrection degree 3 per polarity, HYPER_POLY (l2 1e-4, lr 3e-3, 2000 steps), per-fold training records, frozen in refit (max_nfev 400)
arms.B4: GPCorrection fit_gp (2000 points, rng 0, L-BFGS-B maxiter 200), per fold, frozen in refit (max_nfev 400)

part_A.comparison_rows: stored C0_refit, M_bias v1, selected g v2 rows via scripts/research/plot_freeze_draft.py datasets()
part_A.statistic: GMR = exp(mean ln ratio), percentile bootstrap 10000 seed 0, device unit (TU Delft 7-group cluster); i3_2_bias.paired_ratio
part_A.outcome_rule: X matches g v2 iff non-inferior on all 3 of G; g v2 ahead of X iff 'g v2 better than X' on all 3 of G; outcome 'selected g v2 not matched by a correction-stage baseline' iff no X matches, else 'matched by X'
part_A.pooled: exp(mean ln GMR vs C0_refit) over 9 datasets per arm

validity.VA1: C0_refit rerun = stored C0_refit rows, max |diff| <= 1e-12
validity.VA2: row for every DEV device per arm; non-finite <= 10% per arm
validity.VA5_reported: IHP B1/B2/B3_d3 reruns vs I5-1 rows

part_A.invalid_dataset: left out of the outcome; an invalid dataset of G makes the outcome 'not evaluated'

part_B.unit: one NGSpice call = one simulation of a device's measured bias set (polish n_sim)
items: g v2 inner selection refits (stored n_sim or estimate = n_inner_refits x median held-out n_sim, labeled)

part_C.problem: C0_refit stage: state-C starting card direct43_r3_fd, 43-parameter round-3 box, local [-1, 1], DeviceProblem
part_C.objective: device paper RRMS = mean frozen included curve RRMS; non-finite = 10

LS.budget: B_d = n_sim of the traced LS run

part_C.budget: each CMA-ES / TuRBO run 4 B_d calls; matched result = best-so-far at B_d; secondary at 4 B_d
part_C.statistic: per device exp(mean over 3 seeds ln best-so-far f at B_d); GMR(method, LS), device bootstrap 10000 seed 0

validity.VC1: traced LS = stored C0_refit rows, max |diff| <= 1e-12
validity.VC2: exact budgets; re-simulated best card = traced value within 1e-12

predictions.P1: sky130: g v2 better than B1, B2, B3_d3, B4
predictions.P2: NIST lvt and RT card: g v2 better than B1, B2, B4; B3_d3 non-inferior to g v2 on both
predictions.P3: IHP each temperature: B1 gains over C0_refit and is better than g v2
predictions.P4: TU Delft each temperature: g v2 better than B1 by point estimate; every label vs g v2 inconclusive
predictions.P5: outcome 'selected g v2 not matched by a correction-stage baseline'
predictions.P6: Part C: LS better than CMA-ES and than TuRBO at the matched budget (primary configurations)
predictions.P7: g v2 nested selection uses more NGSpice calls than all held-out refits of the g v2 arm on every dataset where it was run

order: code, unit tests, smoke, BoTorch install, commit
queue: screens, Part A per dataset, Part C, cost, decide
decision.json, report batch, site claim, RESEARCH_LOOP outcome, freeze draft item 12, memory, commit + push
compute_estimate: Part A 2-3 h, Part C 1-2 h (8 workers)
